ayahs.textArabic: الۤمّۤ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Alif lām mīm.
ayahs.textEnglish: Alif. Lam. Mim.

ayahs.textArabic: تَنْزِيْلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Tanzīlul-kitābi lā raiba fīhi mir rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: The bestowal from on high of this divine writ issues, beyond any doubt, from the Sustainer of all the worlds:

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ اَتٰىهُمْ مِّنْ نَّذِيْرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Am yaqūlūnaftarāhu balhuwal-ḥaqqu mir rabbika litunżira qaumam mā atāhum min nażīrim min qablika la‘allahum yahtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and yet, they [who are bent on denying the truth] assert, “[Muhammad] has invented it!” Nay, but it is the truth from thy Sustainer, enabling thee to warn [this] people to whom no warner has come before thee, so that they might follow the right path.

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِيْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِۗ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا شَفِيْعٍۗ  اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhul-lażī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa mā bainahumā fī sittati ayyāmin ṡummastawā ‘alal-‘arsy(i), mā lakum min dūnihī miw waliyyiw wa lā syafī‘(in), afalā tatażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: IT IS GOD who has created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six aeons, and is established on the throne of His almightiness. You have none to protect you from God, and none to intercede for you [on Judgment Day]: will you not, then, bethink yourselves?

ayahs.textArabic: يُدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ اِلَيْهِ فِيْ يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗٓ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yudabbirul-amra minas-samā'i ilal-arḍi ṡumma ya‘ruju ilaihi fī yaumin kāna miqdāruhū alfa sanatim mimmā ta‘uddūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: He governs all that exists, from the celestial space to the earth; and in the end all shall ascend unto Him [for judgment] on a Day the length whereof will be [like] a thousand years of your reckoning.

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكَ عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālika ‘ālimul-gaibi wasy-syahādatil-‘azīzur-raḥīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Such is He who knows all that is beyond the reach of a created being’s perception, as well as all that can be witnessed by a creature’s senses or mind: the Almighty, the Dispenser of Grace,

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْٓ اَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهٗ وَبَدَاَ خَلْقَ الْاِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażī aḥsana kulla syai'in khalaqahū wa bada'a khalqal-insāni min ṭīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: who makes most excellent everything that He creates. Thus, He begins the creation of man out of clay;

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهٗ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ مَّاۤءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma ja‘ala naslahū min sulālatim mim mā'im mahīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: then He causes him to be begotten out of the essence of a humble fluid;

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ سَوّٰىهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِهٖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـِٕدَةَۗ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma sawwāhu wa nafakha fīhi mir rūḥihī wa ja‘ala lakumus-sam‘a wal-abṣāra wal-af'idah(ta), qalīlam mā tasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and then He forms him in accordance with what he is meant to be, and breathes into him of His spirit: and [thus, O men,] He endows you with hearing, and sight, and feelings as well as minds: [yet] how seldom are you grateful!

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْٓا ءَاِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ءَاِنَّا لَفِيْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيْدٍ ەۗ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَاۤءِ رَبِّهِمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū a'iżā ḍalalnā fil-arḍi a'innā lafī khalqin jadīd(in), bal hum biliqā'i rabbihim kāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, [many are] they [who] say, “What! After we have been [dead and] lost in the earth, shall we indeed be [restored to life] in a new act of crea­tion?” Nay, but [by saying this] they deny the truth that they are destined to meet their Sustainer!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِيْ وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yatawaffākum malakul-mautil-lażī wukkila bikum ṡumma ilā rabbikum turja‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “[One day,] the angel of death who has been given charge of you will gather you, and then unto your Sustainer you will be brought back.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ تَرٰىٓ اِذِ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ نَاكِسُوْا رُءُوْسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْۗ رَبَّنَآ اَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا اِنَّا مُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau tarā iżil-mujrimūna nākisū ru'ūsihim ‘inda rabbihim, rabbanā abṣarnā wa sami‘nā farji‘nā na‘mal ṣāliḥan innā mūqinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: If thou couldst but see [how it will be on Judgment Day], when those who are lost in sin will hang their heads before their Sustainer, [saying:] “O our Sustainer! [Now] we have seen, and we have heard! Return us, then, [to our earthly life] that we may do good deeds: for [now], behold, we are certain [of the truth]!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَاٰتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدٰىهَا وَلٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّيْ لَاَمْلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau syi'nā la'ātainā kulla nafsin hudāhā wa lākin ḥaqqal-qaulu minnī la'amla'anna  jahannama minal-jinnati wan-nāsi ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet had We so willed, We could indeed have imposed Our guidance upon every human being: but [We have not willed it thus - and so] that word of Mine has come true: “Most certainly will I fill hell with invisible beings as well as with humans, all together!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَذُوْقُوْا بِمَا نَسِيْتُمْ لِقَاۤءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَاۚ اِنَّا نَسِيْنٰكُمْ وَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa żūqū bimā nasītum liqā'a yaumikum hāżā, innā nasīnākum wa żūqū ‘ażābal-khuldi bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And He will say unto the sinners:] “Taste, then, [the recompense] for your having been obli­vious of the coming of this your Day [of Judgment] - for, verily, We are [now] oblivious of you: taste, then, [this] abiding suffering for all [the evil] that you were wont to do!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا الَّذِيْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِهَا خَرُّوْا سُجَّدًا وَّسَبَّحُوْا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ ۩
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā yu'minu bi'āyātinal-lażīna iżā żukkirū bihā kharrū sujjadaw wa sabbaḥū biḥamdi rabbihim wa hum lā yastakbirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: ONLY THEY [truly] believe in Our messages who, whenever they are conveyed to them, fall down, prostrating themselves in adoration, and extol their Sustainer’s limitless glory and praise; and who are never filled with false pride;

ayahs.textArabic: تَتَجَافٰى جُنُوْبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًاۖ وَّمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Tatajāfā junūbuhum ‘anil-maḍāji‘i yad‘ūna rabbahum khaufaw wa ṭama‘ā(n), wa mimmā razaqnāhum yunfiqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] who are im­pelled to rise from their beds [at night] to call out to their Sustainer in fear and hope; and who spend on others out of what We provide for them as sus­tenance.

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّآ اُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ قُرَّةِ اَعْيُنٍۚ جَزَاۤءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falā ta‘lamu nafsum mā ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a‘yun(in), jazā'am bimā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [as for all such believers,] no human being can imagine what blissful delights, as yet hidden, await them [in the life to come] as a reward for all that they did.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًاۗ  لَا يَسْتَوٗنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Afaman kāna mu'minan kaman kāna fāsiqā(n), lā yastawūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Is, then, he who [in his earthly life] was a believer to be compared with one who was in­iquitous? [Nay,] these two are not equal!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنّٰتُ الْمَأْوٰىۖ  نُزُلًا ۢبِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ammal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti falahum jannātul-ma'wā, nuzulam bimā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As for those who attain to faith and do right­eous deeds - gardens of rest await them, as a wel­come [from God], in result of what they did;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ فَسَقُوْا فَمَأْوٰىهُمُ النَّارُ كُلَّمَآ اَرَادُوْٓا اَنْ يَّخْرُجُوْا مِنْهَآ اُعِيْدُوْا فِيْهَا وَقِيْلَ لَهُمْ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ammal-lażīna fasaqū fa ma'wākumun nāru kullamā arādū ay yakhrujū minhā u‘īdū fīhā wa qīla lahum żūqū ‘ażāban nāril-lażī kuntum bihī tukażżibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: but as for those who are lost in iniquity - their goal is the fire: as oft as they will try to come out of it, they will be thrown back into it; and they will be told, “Taste [now] this suffering through fire which you were wont to call a lie!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَنُذِيْقَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَدْنٰى دُوْنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lanużīqannahum minal-‘ażābil-adnā dūnal-‘ażābil-akbari la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: However, ere [We condemn them to] that supreme suffering, We shall most certainly let them taste of a suffering closer at hand, so that they might [repent and] mend their ways.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ ثُمَّ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا ۗاِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa man aẓlamu mimman żukkira bi'āyāti rabbihī ṡumma a‘raḍa ‘anhā, innā minal-mujrimīna muntaqimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And who could be more wicked than he to whom his Sustainer’s messages are conveyed and who thereupon turns away from them? Verily, We shall inflict Our retribution on those who are [thus] lost in sin!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِيْ مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْ لِّقَاۤىِٕهٖ وَجَعَلْنٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ātainā mūsal-kitāba falā takun fī miryatim mil liqā'ihī wa ja‘alnāhu hudal libanī isrā'īl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, [O Muhammad,] We did vouchsafe revelation unto Moses [as well]: so be not in doubt of [thy] having met with the same [truth in the revelation vouchsafed to thee]. And [just as] We caused that [earlier revelation] to be a guidance for the children of Israel,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ اَىِٕمَّةً يَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْاۗ وَكَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ja‘alnā minhum a'immatay yahdūna bi'amrinā lammā ṣabarū, wa kānū bi'āyātinā yūqinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [as] We raised among them leaders who, so long as they bore themselves with patience and had sure faith in Our messages, guided [their people] in accordance with Our behest [so, too, shall it be with the divine writ revealed unto thee, O Muhammad.]

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna rabbaka huwa yafṣilu bainahum yaumal-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, it is God alone who will decide between men on Resurrection Day with regard to all on which they were wont to differ.

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ يَمْشُوْنَ فِيْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْ ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍۗ اَفَلَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā min qablihim minal-qurūni yamsyūna fī masākinihim, inna fī żālika la'āyāt(in), afalā yasma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But] can, then, they [who deny the truth] learn no lesson by recalling how many a generation We have destroyed before their time? [people] in whose dwelling-places they [themselves now] walk about? In this, behold, there are messages indeed: will they not, then, listen?

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا نَسُوْقُ الْمَاۤءَ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهٖ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ اَنْعَامُهُمْ وَاَنْفُسُهُمْۗ اَفَلَا يُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yarau annā nasūqul-mā'a ilal-arḍil juruzi fanukhriju bihī zar‘an ta'kulu minhu an‘āmuhum wa anfushum, afalā yubṣirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Are they not aware that it is We who drive the rain onto dry land devoid of herbage, and thereby bring forth herbage of which their cattle and they themselves do eat? Can they not, then, see [the truth of resurrection]?

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْفَتْحُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaqūlūna matā hāżal-fatḥu in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But they answer: “When will that final decision take place, if what you [believers] say is true?”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِيْمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul yaumal-fatḥi lā yanfa‘ul-lażīna kafarū īmānuhum wa lā hum yunẓarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “On the Day of the Final Decision, their [newly-found] faith will be of no use to those who [in their lifetime] were bent on denying the truth, nor will they be granted respite!” –

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانْتَظِرْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّنْتَظِرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa a‘riḍ ‘anhum wantaẓir innahum muntaẓirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and then leave them alone, and wait [for the truth to unfold as] they, behold, are waiting.
